title: Backup and restore
intro: Nobody else holds a copy of this installation. If the disk in this machine dies and there is no backup somewhere else, the calls and the transcripts are gone.
verdict_ok_title: Backed up nightly, last one 8 hours ago
verdict_ok_body: Read back and verified after writing, so it is known to restore. Fourteen daily snapshots and three months of weekly ones are kept.
verdict_stale_title: The last good backup is 9 days old
verdict_stale_body: The nightly job has failed every night since 12 August: the network share stopped accepting the connection. Nine days of calls exist only on this machine.
verdict_none_title: There is no backup of this installation
verdict_none_body: Every call, transcript and contact exists on exactly one disk. Pick somewhere for it to go — a network share takes about two minutes to set up.
running_note: Calls are still being answered. The backup reads a snapshot, so a call happening right now is simply in the next one.
target_nas_body: The business NAS or any SMB share. Cheap, fast, and in the same building — which is also its weakness.
target_nas_note: A fire or a theft takes the machine and the backup together. Pair this with one of the off-site options.
target_s3_body: Hetzner, Wasabi, Backblaze, MinIO on your own hardware. Encrypted before it leaves this machine.
target_s3_note: Encrypted with a key held only here. Lose the key and the provider cannot help you — write it down somewhere physical.
target_usb_body: Plugged into this machine. Works, but only if somebody remembers to swap and take one home.
target_usb_note: The most commonly forgotten option. Tel-Agent warns you here if no disk has been seen for a week.
target_none_body: No backup at all. Everything lives on one disk in one machine.
target_none_note: One failed disk and every call, transcript and contact is gone, with no copy anywhere.
part_config_note: Everything you configured, with the SIP and API passwords encrypted.
part_db_note: The database. Without this a restore gives you an empty installation.
part_transcripts_note: Searchable text of every call still within its retention period.
part_recordings_note: The bulk of it. Leaving these out makes backups 60× smaller — and leaves you unable to prove what was said.
part_models_note: No reason to include them. A restore re-downloads them in a few minutes.
schedule_with_audio: Nightly at 03:00, when nobody is calling.
schedule_without_audio: Nightly at 03:00. Recordings excluded — restores will have transcripts but no audio.
snapshots_retention: Daily for 14 days, then one a week for 3 months.
snapshot_nightly: Nightly, automatic. Verified by reading it back.
snapshot_before_update: Taken automatically before the version change.
snapshot_failed: Written, but the read-back check failed halfway. Do not rely on this one.
snapshot_weekly: Kept for three months, then deleted.
restore_body: This replaces everything on the machine with the state it was in then. It is the one action here that destroys data.
restore_fact_data: Every call, transcript and contact created since then is deleted. There is no undo and no second copy.
restore_fact_line: The phone line drops for about a minute while the agent restarts. Callers in that minute hear it ring out.
restore_fact_settings: Settings go back too — a number you added or a rule you changed since then is gone with the rest.
error_offline_title: The server could not be reached
target_unwritable: This target cannot be written to right now: {detail}
verdict_stale_body_real: The last backup that was verified is {days} day(s) old. Everything since exists on this machine only.
verdict_running_body_real: A backup is running. Calls are still being answered.
queued: Backup started. It will appear below when it finishes.
snapshot_missing: The archive is no longer at the path it was written to.
no_snapshots: No backup of this installation has ever been taken.
delete_confirm: Delete this archive? The file is removed from the target and cannot be recovered.
restore_staged_title: Restore staged — restart to carry it out
restore_staged_body: Nothing has changed yet. The restore happens on the next start, and until then this installation is untouched.
